title: Chapter 7000: You’Re Him
content:
Chapter 7000: You’Re Him

Chapter 7000: You’re Him

A world ruled by an immortal was fully under its master’s dominion. Once caught, resisting was impossible, let alone destroying it.

“Damn!” However, Till Ancestor was shocked to see his world shatter upon a single glance.

The immortal decisively burned his true blood to escape from Dusk Realm and Ruin.Alas, Li Qiye’s supreme will suppressed him, forcing him back in place.

“Activate!” He shouted as his feet sank into the ground, mustering all of his energy to resist. Unfortunately, this was futile and only his head was above ground.

Mo Xiangsheng couldn’t believe an immortal was so helpless before Li Qiye. As for Till Ancestor, he felt as if he was a worm being stomped to the ground.

He was scared out of his wits, never having thought he would find himself in this situation after becoming immortal. Even a celestial immortal shouldn’t have been able to do so with a single glance.

“This...” Mo Xiangsheng’s teeth chattered from fear: “Please, show mercy...”

Just speaking required all of his courage. After all, Till Ancestor was the one who challenged Li Qiye. He thought such a powerful being would not tolerate disrespect. Till Ancestor might just be crushed right now.

“Pop!” Li Qiye recalled his supreme will and allowed the man to climb out of the ground.

Time flowed normally as if nothing had happened. Everything seemed like a dream as Li Qiye sipped another cup of tea prepared bay Ye Fantian.

Till Ancestor, who had just taken a trip to hell and back, looked as pale as could be. As for Mo Xiangsheng, he dropped butt-first to the ground and heaved a sigh of relief.

“You... you’re him, Li Qiye.” Till Ancestor recalled a recent legend.

“Indeed.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Li Qiye?” Mo Xiangsheng hasn’t heard of this before.

“The destroyer of Breaker.” Till Ancestor’s eyes were filled with fear.

He spent most of his life in seclusion but after leaving his home this time, he heard about the destruction of the Breaker branch and its reformation.

Most terrifying of all, the destroyer only waved his hand to obliterate the celestial immortal. When he first heard this, he thought it was nonsense or greatly exaggerated.

Now, Li Qiye’s glance reminded him of the legend and verified its validity.
